synthetic_codec_unseen.description: Runnable reproduction-gym replacement for the unreleased Koel-TTS/NanoCodec setup. Targets encode the expected behavior on the fixed synthetic multi-codebook codec task: local-transformer methods should produce valid dependent codebook tuples with fewer primary steps under frame stacking.

token_accuracy.description: Exact-token accuracy on the evaluated half of the fixed synthetic codec test split.

dependency_validity.description: Fraction of dependent codebook entries satisfying the synthetic codec dependency rule.

codec_fd.description: Distributional distance between predicted and reference deterministic codec-frame embeddings.

speaker_conditioned_codec_fd.description: Average per-speaker codec embedding distance, added to catch methods that match global statistics while collapsing speaker structure.

primary_steps_per_24_frames.description: Machine-independent decoding-effort proxy derived from the artifact stack factor.
